messages:
Elaine: quick sync — FinBank pushed back on our default tiers. they need a higher-per-route throughput addon and want trial caps tightened before pilots. can we decide tradeoffs by EOD?
Liam: context: sales needs a priceable SKU for >10k rps per-route for low-latency routing. they say competition offers it as an add-on.
Nora: engineering note: per-route isolation at that scale requires dedicated queues or reserved workers; cost delta ~2.5x per-request. not impossible but needs a dedicated rollout path.
Marcus: finance: if we price it as a premium addon we must guard against cannibalization of Dedicated. recommend minimum 3mo commitment or higher price-per-token.
Priya: legal: for shorter pilots we can do a limited-term top-up, but enterprise contract changes need: (1) SLA carveout for add-on latency, (2) explicit overage billing rules.
Elaine: propose two options: A) "Priority Route Add-on" (burstable, +2.5x unit price, 3mo min) B) "Route Reservation" (reserved capacity, monthly commit, higher price). which do we favour?
Liam: customer wants A ideally, but with hard trial cap lower than our standard. asks: trial = 1M tokens total for their pilot.
Marcus: 1M trial tokens is fine if we mark them as non-rollover and tag for cost analytics. need to add a usage floor on conversion.
Ravi: ops question: can we implement A as a feature-flagged config? we can wire a per-route priority weight and backpressure. timeframe: 3 sprints to safe rollout + canary.
Nora: canary plan: 10% of traffic on staging cluster -> measure tail latency, cost delta. gating metrics: tail p99 < 75ms and cost per 1k tokens within forecast +/-10%.
Priya: draft contract clause for A: 
```
ADD-ON: Priority Route Add-on
Commitment: minimum 3 months.
SLA: Add-on does not inherit base model SLA; vendor provides best-effort low-latency routing.
Overage: billed monthly at 2.5x standard rate for add-on tokens.
```
Liam: can we offer a pilot exception for FinBank: 1M trial tokens + no charge if they convert to 6mo commitment within 30 days?
Marcus: finance: we can trial-credit up to 1M if conversion to >= 6mo occurs, otherwise credits expire. need auto-flag for billing.
Elaine: decision needed: do we put A as experimental add-on behind an opt-in "pilot" with explicit trial terms or launch A publicly?
Ravi: recommend opt-in pilot (feature flag + canary). public launch after 2 successful pilots. engineering effort is moderate and we need monitoring hooks.
Priya: legal ok with pilot exception, will prepare amendment template.
Nora: ops: will add tagging + trace points to console so product and sales can see per-customer cost in realtime. ETA: 2 weeks for basic telemetry.
Marcus: pricing ask: propose list price = 2.5x base token rate, pilot credit path as discussed, margin target 30%.
Elaine: launch criteria checklist (proposed):
- pilot with 2 customers (FinBank + 1)
- p99 latency within threshold across pilots
- billing telemetry integrated into console
- contract amendment and legal template approved
- internal pricing and playbook published
If all met -> GA in next release cycle.
Liam: i'll prep customer-facing one-pager and pilot offer language.
Priya: i'll drop amendment draft in the thread shortly.
Ravi: will allocate eng spike this sprint to confirm per-route isolation perf.
Nora: will set up dashboard and a short runbook for SEs.
LegalBot: document created: /contracts/amendments/priority-route-addendum-draft-v1 (for review).
Elaine: ok — thanks everyone. leaning to pilot-only A with the trial credit conversion path. I'll summarize and post a formal PRD after legal and finance confirm the exact wording. :white_check_mark:
Liam: thanks — i'll loop in FinBank and confirm if they'll sign the 6mo conversion.
Marcus: noted, will update pricing sheet and show net revenue scenarios.
Priya: ping me once the PRD is up, i'll review clause language.
Elaine: end — action items: Liam: customer confirm; Priya: amendment; Marcus: pricing SKU; Ravi: eng spike; Nora: telemetry + runbook. target: EOD next Wed for PRD draft.
